text: Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of this Agreement.
A change to a unit price takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively.
The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 14 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank Negara Indonesia, number 0712264490, in the name of Borneo Hygiene Services.
Late payment accrues interest of 2% per month on the overdue amount.
The Supplier shall supply cleaning supplies and services to the Buyer against purchase orders issued by the Buyer.
Each purchase order forms an integral part of this Agreement.
